description: The FlyEnv license supports the ongoing development and maintenance of the project. It is not intended to block core local development — core runtimes and environment management features will always remain accessible. A license removes the evaluation limits of premium tools and helps keep FlyEnv maintained across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

restrictions.title: FlyEnv remains functional without a license, but the following evaluation limits apply:

items.0: Site management is limited to a maximum of 3 local sites.
items.1: The AI assistant is limited to a 3-day trial.
items.2: The screenshot tool is limited to a 3-day trial.
items.3: The image optimizer is limited to a 3-day trial.
items.4: New premium features may be subject to similar trial periods or limits.

howToObtain.title: How to Get Licensed
howToObtain.description: FlyEnv offers the following three ways to obtain a license. Licenses cannot be issued automatically yet, so all requests are reviewed and issued manually:

0.title: Purchase a Personal License
0.description: A FlyEnv Personal License costs $10 USD. It covers one active device (device transfer is supported via license management) and removes all evaluation limits. Checkout is processed by Paddle. After purchasing, submit your Paddle order ID in the request form below. Purchase page:

1.title: Contribute to the Codebase
1.description: Submit a Pull Request on GitHub to help improve FlyEnv. Every meaningful contribution counts — from major features to simple documentation fixes.

2.title: Spread the Word
2.description: Share your FlyEnv experience on any platform in any language — articles, videos, blogs, or posts. Content must be original and authentic; content published more than 3 months ago may no longer be eligible.

submitInfo: After completing any of the methods above, paste your proof into the message box below together with a valid email address, then click the 'Request License' button. Requests are processed manually, usually within 24 hours, and you will be notified by email once your license has been issued.
messagePlaceholder:
Purchasers: your Paddle order ID or receipt email.
Contributors: the link to your GitHub Pull Request.
Promoters: the link to your post, video, or article.
Please also include a valid email address so we can notify you once the license is issued.
licenseInfo: The current license is permanent and follows a one-license-per-device policy. Each license is tied to a specific hardware UUID. If you switch to a new computer, log in with your GitHub account and go to 'My Licenses' to unbind the old device and bind the new one, or request a new license.
logoutTips: Are you sure you want to log out?
delBindTips: Are you sure to unbind the license from this UUID?
addBindTips: Are you sure to bind the license to this UUID?
oauthSuccessMessage: This page can be closed. Please return to FlyEnv to view the license information.
trialExpiredTips: You have been using FlyEnv for {days} days. If FlyEnv has been helpful to you, please consider obtaining a license to support the project.
